load_bearing_change: Blade arrival truncates the work accumulated on recruited fiber bridges; distinguish micro cleavage from prior pullout work instead of identifying them with a radius-zero intercept
derived_relation: T(delta)=2 phi tau (l-delta)_+/r_f; W_before_blade=phi tau/r_f (2l delta_b-delta_b^2), capped at full pullout work
closure_for_counterexample_only: delta_b=2R. No measured skin map from radius to bridge opening; result conditional. Sweep R=0..l/2 and examine R=r_f and R=2r_f.
measurement_instrument: synthetic observations only: y(R)=Gamma0+B0+A(R/20um)+B f(R); f=2q-q^2, q=min(2R/l,1). Includes layer-model prestress correction when force is interpreted.
acquisitions: independent pre-cleavage bridge traction-opening work at a measured local opening
gate: Γ0 identification interval halfwidth <=30 J/m2; no empirical validation claim
falsifiers: radius-only Jacobian does not separate Gamma0 from B0
radius near fiber diameter does not approach tear energy under explicit bridge closure
contact removal alone does not eliminate constant process null direction
strongest_control: Same-information conventional positive constrained least squares / linear programming cohesive inverse; all acquisitions and bounds available to it
if_control_matches: Report TIE. Execute the new independent-work acquisition and identify exact residual noise/constitutive assumptions; no cached-ROM claim.
cost: count LP solves and FE release evaluation; acquisition precision is a scenario requirement, not real achievable measurement noise
